summary: Allow host migration when the configured checkpoint worker is disabled

rules.detail: The mover requires pending-null only when checkpoint.enabled or trim.local can spawn the checkpoint worker; replication quiescence is unchanged. Missing, unreadable or invalid daemon configuration refuses migration.

compatibility.detail: Works with existing daemons that synthesize pending checkpoint cuts while their worker is disabled; no daemon upgrade is required. JSON receipts add checkpoint_gate with worker-disabled or pending-null.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime; the explicit host cutover procedure is unchanged.

manual.detail: Use the same --config override as the daemon, if any, as before. Previously refused migrations may be retried with the updated mover.

recovery.detail: Existing migration rollback remains available. Revert this change to restore unconditional checkpoint pending-null gating.
